question: what was the percentage change in diluted earnings per common share december 29 2012 and december 28 2013?
reasoning: We need answer percentage change in diluted EPS from 2012 to 2013. Diluted EPS 2012 $2.13, 2013 $1.89. Change = (1.89-2.13)/2.13 = -0.24/2.13 = -11.2676%. So -11.3% approx. Need evidence figures.
raw_content:
<evidence>
2.13 | Consolidated Statements of Income - Diluted earnings per common share 2012
1.89 | Consolidated Statements of Income - Diluted earnings per common share 2013
</evidence>
<program>divide(subtract(1.89, 2.13), 2.13)</program>
<answer>-11.3%</answer>
